name: Unagi
source:
A white female ferret that can transform into a humanoid hybrid; she is the only notable such hybrid of its type in any form of literature. In her humanoid form, Unagi is indistinguishable from a normal human except for her white tail and animal ears. She does not get along with [url=/c12305]Mii[/url] at all as Mii becomes jealous of the time she spends with [url=/c12299]Chris[/url].

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Popotan_characters#Unagi]Wikipedia[/url].]
